{{< include latex-macros/macros.qmd >}}

:::{.callout-note}

See the [general procedure for interpreting a regression coefficient](Linear-models-overview.qmd#def-coef-interp-procedure) for full details, including how to handle [interaction terms](Intro-to-GLMs.qmd#def-interaction-term) and how to set remaining covariates to their reference values.

**In order to interpret $\beta_j$**:
differentiate or difference $\red{\eta(\vx)}$ with respect to $\red{x_j}$ (depending on whether $x_j$ is continuous or discrete, respectively):

$$\deriv{\red{x_j}} \red{\eta(\vx)}$$

**In order to find the [MLE](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-mle) $\hat{\vb}$**:
differentiate the [log-likelihood function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-loglik) $\teal{\llik(\vb)}$ 
with respect to $\teal{\vb}$:

$$\deriv{\teal{\vb}} \teal{\llik(\vb)}$$

:::
